_ordering_rationale: Ordre par PV: 3 segments continuing (MPT, HST, Pharma), puis Kidney Care (spin-off event) puis Total.

kpis.signal: Plus gros segment BAX post-Vantive (Kidney) spinoff. IV solutions, infusion pumps, anesthesia.
kpis.description_fr: MPT = Medical Products & Therapies. Pompes infusion, solutions IV, anesthésie, nutrition parentérale.
kpis.description_en: MPT = Medical Products & Therapies. Infusion pumps, IV solutions, anesthesia, parenteral nutrition.

kpis.signal: Acquisition Hillrom 2022. Lits hôpitaux, écosystème connecté, surgical equipment.
kpis.description_fr: HST = Hillrom héritage. Lits hôpitaux, écosystème connecté, surgical solutions. Stable 2024.
kpis.description_en: HST = Hillrom legacy. Hospital beds, connected ecosystem, surgical solutions. Stable 2024.

kpis.signal: Anesthésiques, génériques injectables (Vials, premixes). Marche stable.
kpis.description_fr: Pharmaceuticals: anesthésiques, génériques injectables, premixed IV drugs. Croissance modeste.
kpis.description_en: Pharmaceuticals: anesthetics, injectable generics, premixed IV drugs. Modest growth.

kpis.signal: Spin-off Vantive complété janvier 2025. Dialyse rénale (hémo + péritonéale). N'est plus dans BAX 2025+.
kpis.description_fr: Kidney Care = dialyse rénale. Spin-off en Vantive complété janvier 2025. BAX maintenant pure-play hospital.
kpis.description_en: Kidney Care = renal dialysis. Vantive spin-off completed January 2025. BAX now hospital pure-play.

kpis.signal: CA post-Vantive divestment. Reset opération à ~11 Mds $ pour BAX nouveau périmètre.
kpis.description_fr: CA continuing operations (hors Kidney Care divested). Reset à ~11 Mds $ pour BAX restructuré.
kpis.description_en: Continuing operations revenue (ex divested Kidney Care). ~$11B reset for restructured BAX.

_notes: Baxter International. Spun off Vantive (Kidney Care) January 2025. BAX now pure-play hospital products.
